paired.home_community: largest sum of source present raw codepoints in calendar2017 and2018; lexicographic tie
paired.author_identity: casefolded actual source account; identity used only by evaluator/selection, never feature calculations
paired.split_rule: int(sha256(author_split_salt + ':' + casefolded_author),16) modulo3 in splits order
paired.rank_rule: descending min(eligible words in early cell, eligible words in late cell), then SHA256(author_rank_salt + ':' + casefolded_author)
paired.pre_shortlist_rank: descending min(present raw codepoints in calendar2017, calendar2018), then author_rank hash
paired.selection_eligibility: present usable English-assumed comments with at least20 retained words; whole original records only
paired.block_pairing: minimum sum of absolute differences between account cell-median timestamps for early and late; enumerate all3perfectmatchings of4accounts; lexicographic author-hash tie
paired.shared_word_budget: B=max(1000,min(3000,min eligible-word capacities of Aearly,Alate,Bearly,Blate))); independent B for within and cross conditions, derived before selecting records or scoring
paired.selection_order: absolute UTC distance from cell center, then actual UTC timestamp, then original recordID; accumulate whole eligible records until Bwords and8records, or exhaust; canonical order in exports
paired.cross_rule: same paired accounts: early homecommunity, late next community in communities cycle; unsupported remains empty/abstained
paired.hash50: keep iff int(SHA256(omission_salt + ':' + original_recordID),16) modulo2 equals0
paired.middle50: remove indices floor(n/4) through floor(3*n/4)-1 from each complete baseunit in canonical chronological order
paired.drop_Cornell: remove original source records whose subreddit is Cornell
paired.omission_policy: same base units and budgets; unchanged surviving records, no refill or replacement
paired.chunking: one predefined homecommunity/condition/arm/method dataset document, both development/evaluation; only selected subset snapshots; confirmation physically absent
paired.unfilled_slot_policy: report all pre-score exclusions/unfilled slots; no replacements after cohort freeze or purge
paired.missing_time_matching: If any required median is missing, matchingcost is null with reason missing_cell_median; choose lexicographically smallest orderedauthorhash perfectmatching.

leakage.population: pre-purge eligible candidate records of selected36accounts in all3communities and both fixedtimecells, before budget selection
leakage.thread: purge all records in any actual thread containing selected records in multiple splits, symmetrically
leakage.exact: Nonempty tuple of normalized lexical-token segments, numbers retained and segment boundaries preserved. Empty retainedtext is an audited singleton.

near.comparison_rule: Integer decisions:100*intersection>=80*union OR100*intersection>=90*leftsize OR100*intersection>=90*rightsize; bothrecords>=20wordtokens,>=5sharedunique segment-local5shingles. Explicit evaluator adaptation, not production50word evidenceguard.
near.cap_accounting: Every unique recordpair sharing any5shingle before verification; cap exhaustion blocks scoring as not_auditable.

leakage.quotation: recognized CommonMark blockquote word phrases versus retained15-token phrases; unmarked/indirect quotation unknown
leakage.components: connected components of exact/near/template/quotation relations; purge all members of any component crossing splits; no iterative refills
leakage.missing_metadata: omit missing dimensions and report not_auditable; never synthesize passed evidence
leakage.source_document: actual global Reddit recordIDs; document-level disjointness only. All folds share the ConvoKit/Pushshift collection and are not independent corpus replications.
leakage.confirmation: inventory/provenance/leakage checks permitted; no distances, comparison scores or representation selection; no confirmation records in scored dataset documents
leakage.missing_content: Explicit non-presenttextNone contributes no observedtokens; annotate content-unobservable and available-retainedtext-only audit scope. A singleton does not prove missingtext independent. Missingbody without explicit nonpresentstatus is not_auditable.

chronological.candidate_order: SHA256(chronology_salt + ':' + casefolded_author); select first4eligible perhomecommunity after all fixed exclusions, no grid/score eligibility gate
chronological.excluded_accounts: all originalpilot12 and all selectedpaired36 including confirmation; placeholders/AutoModerator
chronological.confirmation_exclusion: Cheap fullauthor/thread/source exclusion, then joint selected12wholehistory+pairedcandidatepool related-componentaudit; reject anywholechronoauthor touchingconfirmationcomponent without refill, recordunfilledslots. Otherknownsplitdependence makeschronologyexploratory.
chronological.pairing: closest account median timestamps with deterministic author-hash ties; every sourceaccount in one pair only
chronological.cut: median of union actual creation timestamps of a sourcepair; A strictlybeforecut, B atoraftercut; source text/times/IDs unchanged, constructed accountmetadata reassigned
chronological.truth: first surviving B record's zero-based original constructed snapshot ordinal; unknown or missing one side is not a labeled unchanged construction
chronological.omissions: same recordhash rule; contiguous middlehalf of fullconstructed canonical stream; removeCornell. No refills; map truth to survivor ordinals and retain fulloriginal ordinal correspondence.
chronological.continuity_proxy_definition: A-side sourceaccount complete available comment history; [] denotes no observed sourceaccountID reassignment, NOT stable human authorship
chronological.unknown_truth_definition: ordinary analyze, one preregistered Acontrol perhomecommunity; no authorship groundtruth or falsepositive score
chronological.legal_grid: independent eligible whole-record1000word/8record windows; require8qualifiedwindows, minsegment3; enumeratej=3..N-3. Splitinterval[last_left_original_position+1,first_right_original_position].
chronological.interpretation: Separate insufficientinput, adequate_no_candidate, off_target_candidate and grid_unattainable flags; gridunattainable still fails end-to-end10record requirement, no tolerance relaxation
chronological.grouping: audit full originalauthor/thread/source/related components. If strictpartition impossible, mark chronologicalstudy exploratory/not independentlyheldout; do not dropcompletehistory records silently
chronological.operational_chunking: one fullhistory or splice peraccount_stream invocation; max2concurrent analyses, original limits unchanged
chronological.control_arms: All4arms apply to6proxycontrols and6splices (48plannedlabeledcase slots);3unknowntruthnaturalviews are full-only ordinaryanalyze. Reusedsourcehistories are notindependent subjects.
